historical_policy: Reject a candidate feature when its available-by timestamp exceeds the prediction cutoff. Do not backdate retrieval/commit timestamps to season end.
current_pool_choice: Live Fantacalcio Classic quotation snapshot supersedes bootstrap. Exclude only explicit out-of-game markers. Statistics page cannot establish eligibility.
advanced_choice: Audit all five file families at player-season-club grain. Exclude predictive use without a verified Fantacalcio identity crosswalk.
dq_formula: For each prescribed component, multiply its weight by the arithmetic mean of the named measured fractions in data_quality_report.json. Unknown checks receive zero. Hard failures override score.
